# LinkGuard Platform

> LinkGuard Platform is an enterprise-grade URL shortener and analytics engine built for high-speed link management, vector QR code generation, and SHA-256 visitor privacy compliance.

LinkGuard provides sub-10ms URL redirection using a Redis in-memory Cache-Aside pattern and Spring Boot 3.4.

## Details

- [OpenAPI Specification (YAML)](https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/openapi.yaml): Complete OpenAPI 3.0.3 machine-readable API spec in YAML format.
- [Agent Instructions Guide](https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/agent-instructions.md): Step-by-step API execution instructions and cURL request patterns for AI agents.
- [API Documentation](https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/docs): Comprehensive REST API endpoint reference and authentication guides.
- [Full LLM Specification](https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete expanded system documentation for large context window models.
- [XML Sitemap Index](https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap index of all discoverable platform routes.
